stops.name: Parco naturale regionale Litorale di Ugento
stops.detail: The Litorale di Ugento regional park is a protected natural area of Puglia established by Regional Law no. 13 of 28 May [dated source]. The park is located along the Ionian coast, in the southernmost part of the Salento peninsula, and is bordered by the towns of Torre San Giovanni and Lido Marini. Protection, for a depth from the coast of about three kilometers and for a length of eight, a very valuable coastal sequence, consisting of a dunal and retrodunal system, from a series of tidal basins and connecting channels, from an imposing fossil reef with gravine and the more extensive area of Mediterranean scrub of Salento.
